findings.rationale: The post-receive hook was initially written to deploy the main branch to /var/www/main, inconsistent with the nginx root /var/www configured in Step 6, so https://localhost:8443/index.html would not serve main content. This caused the 404 observed in Step 10 and was correctly diagnosed and fixed in Step 11 (deploy main to /var/www), then re-verified end-to-end. Recovered before the final conclusion.
